svg.title: BCBC 2024 · 9.10.9.10 Collapse of Combustible Construction
svg.text: BCBC 2024 · DIVISION B · PART 9 HOUSING AND SMALL BUILDINGS · SECTION 9.10 FIRE PROTECTION

g.text: Combustible floor framing that abuts on
or is supported by the fire separation
The fire separation still stands after
the combustible floor on one side

svg.text: Combustible construction that abuts on or is
supported by a noncombustible fire separation
is constructed so that its collapse under fire
conditions will not cause collapse of the fire
It states the result to achieve. It does not set
Drawn: a slice through a concrete block fire separation with wood floors on both sides. Red dashed: where the floor was.
